description: Election Commission - Member of the Kaduwela Municipal council Mr. P. D. Chandrasena, Mr. R. A. P. R. Perera and Mr.P. G. R. R. Perera Have Resigned.
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Kaduwela Municipal Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate/member status.
